mapper.sql: g.group_id, g.name, g.created_at, g.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plugin_account a WHERE a.installation_id = g.installation_id AND a.group_id = g.group_id) AS account_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM plugin_account_group g WHERE g.installation_id = #{installationId} AND g.group_id = #{groupId}
SELECT FROM plugin_account_group g WHERE g.installation_id = #{installationId} AND g.group_id = #{groupId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE plugin_account_group SET name = #{name}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE installation_id = #{installationId} AND group_id = #{groupId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM plugin_account_group WHERE installation_id = #{installationId} AND group_id = #{groupId}
